nodes.note: Wenna's yard, hedged all round, open to the sky: a wooden gate in a hedge across it on the path to the cottage door.

The cottage: two rooms, the kitchen the front door opens into and the back room behind an oak door; oak trapdoors in the back room's floor over the cellar stair; the iron door to the garden in the back room's north wall, and the latch lever by the east wall.

stations.note: The latch lever on the back room's floor, by its east wall, its rod run under the floor to the iron door.

nodes.note: The cellar under the cottage, down a short stair under the trapdoors in the back room's floor: barrels and a shelf.
The old garden behind the cottage, hedged all round and open to the sky.
